```lean
theorem lg_target (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n := by
  induction n with d hd
  · exact le_refl 0
  · have h1 : d ≤ f d := hd
    have h2 : f d < f (d + 1) := hf d
    have h3 : d < f (d + 1) := h2
    have h4 : d + 1 ≤ f (d + 1) :=
      le_of_lt_add_one h3
    exact h4
```
